offers_products.reason: Sells packaged nutritional snacks and meal products under Quest, Atkins and OWYN brands.

offers_services.reason: Only makes and sells packaged foods; no services are offered to customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Branded bars, chips and shakes are chosen by shoppers in grocery, club, mass and e-commerce channels.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to retailers such as grocery, club and mass merchandisers who buy goods for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Snack bars, shakes and chips are consumables that retailers and shoppers reorder repeatedly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Low-priced everyday food and snack items; demand is fairly stable in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent purchases of snack bars, shakes and chips.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for packaged food products and brands, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are shoppers; retailers are large, but the brand is consumer-facing and sold to households.

asset_heavy.reason: Brand-focused company that relies on third-party co-manufacturers for production.

notes: Co-manufacturing and brand names (Quest, Atkins, OWYN) come from prior knowledge; the website text mentions only Quest.
